segments.name: Pharmaceutical distribution
segments.description: Distributes pharmaceutical products sourced from manufacturers to hospitals, pharmaceutical distributors and other healthcare providers in China.
segments.evidence: The Company's one reportable segment serves its customers primarily by providing pharmaceutical products in China.

revenueModel.text: The company earns revenue by selling pharmaceutical products on a direct basis to hospitals, distributors and other healthcare providers, bearing ownership risks while products are in its possession.
revenueModel.evidence: The Company generates a substantial percentage of its revenue from selling pharmaceutical products on a direct basis, whereby it is exposed to the risks and rewards of ownership of the material while in its possession.

changes.text: In 2026, the company transferred the operations of ABL Chicago to an unrelated third party and ceased its cross-border freight forwarding and logistics business.
changes.evidence: On February 12, 2026, we transferred the operations of ABL Chicago to an unrelated third party, which obtained operational control and substantially all economic interests associated with the business.

changes.text: In 2026, the company changed its corporate name from Lakeside Holding Limited to Quanome Technologies, Inc.
changes.evidence: To align with this strategic direction, effective August 3, 2026, the Company changed its corporate name from Lakeside Holding Limited to Quanome Technologies, Inc.
